g.text: 1. page loads; it makes tab id L and opens its screen stream
3. scroll report from L: section 900 at the top
5. a screen drawn for L: no move needed

text.tspan: 6. a screen drawn for P, with one placement:

g.text: 7. C-x from P: P's keys in progress = C-x

text.tspan: 8. b from L: L has nothing in progress,
so b is typed into the buffer (not C-x b)
9. a screen for P showing the new b,

g.text: 10. a screen for L showing the new b
